video_title: WAS I WRONG NOW?! They Just Traded This Dude to Philly!

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's impact on the Philadelphia 76ers roster
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown is a stud and an MVP candidate fresh over averaging over 28 a game.
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown is a stud and an MVP candidate fresh over averaging over 28 a game. He led the Boston Celtics to a top-two seed within the Eastern Conference without the services of Jason Tatum for more than 60 games this year because he was out with that Achilles tear. We all know what Jaylen Brown brings to the table, so Philadelphia looks in a damn good position.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Bob Myers' front office expertise with the 76ers
quotes.excerpt: Bob Myers, who's presided over the Philadelphia 76ers, no longer the head man of the Golden State Warriors.
quotes.quote: Bob Myers, who's presided over the Philadelphia 76ers, no longer the head man of the Golden State Warriors. We all know that this four-time champion knows what the hell he's doing. So if anybody deserves the benefit of the doubt, it's him. And when you take into account the fact that this deal was made, you got to give credit where credit is due and give him the benefit of the doubt and assume that this man knows what he's doing because he does.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Philadelphia's new core of Brown, Maxey, and Edgecombe
quotes.excerpt: Philadelphia wins this deal because you're pairing Jaylen Brown, who's a dog, who's a stud, with Tyrese Maxey.
quotes.quote: Philadelphia wins this deal because you're pairing Jaylen Brown, who's a dog, who's a stud, with Tyrese Maxey and VJ Edgecombe. You talk about a three-guard tandem right there that's lethal and you shouldn't have any problem getting a bucket. Plus Jaylen Brown's going to defend, and we got to pay attention to that.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Joel Embiid's health concerns and the 76ers' outlook
quotes.excerpt: With Joel Embiid and his questionable health, always a question mark, it's more than apropos.
quotes.quote: With Joel Embiid and his questionable health, always a question mark, it's more than apropos that it's Jaylen Brown that's become a Philadelphia 76er because that's putting your money where your mouth is. Because in case you've forgotten, you do know what he said about Joel Embiid once before, right? Particularly after Boston had lost in the playoffs to the 76ers.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's critical take on Joel Embiid's flopping
quotes.excerpt: Flopping has ruined our game. Joel Embiid is a great player, one of the best bigs.
quotes.quote: This is just my personal opinion on basketball, some of y'all might disagree. Flopping has ruined our game. Joel Embiid is a great player, one of the best bigs in basketball history, but he flops. He know it, this ain't breaking news. It is what it is.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's reaction to playing with Joel Embiid
quotes.excerpt: I bet you Jaylen Brown don't give a shit about him flopping now.
quotes.quote: I bet you Jaylen Brown don't give a shit about him flopping now. I bet you he don't care. How much you want to make a bet he don't give a damn if Joel Embiid flop now, because that's his teammate. And if it works, damn it, do it. Period, end of the discussion, right?

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the trade value of two first-round picks
quotes.excerpt: Knowing and anticipating that the two first-round picks ain't going to be high first-round picks.
quotes.quote: Knowing and anticipating that the two first-round picks ain't going to be high first-round picks, because the Philadelphia 76ers is going to win more games than they lose, you got to give credit where credit is due and say this was a worthy deal to make. Now, there'd been four first-round picks, I'd have had a problem. But two first-round picks for Jaylen Brown, with a guy that's seven years older, six and a half years older than Jaylen Brown, I'm sorry, I don't have a problem with this.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Derrick White and Jrue Holiday's commitment to Boston
quotes.excerpt: Two players in Jrue Holiday and Derrick White, who both spent 82 games a year deferring.
quotes.quote: Two players in Jrue Holiday and Derrick White, who both spent 82 games a year deferring to him and Jason Tatum, they made the team, but he did it. And sneaker deals and stuff like that, he got to start his own brand because, you know what, Nike and Adidas and others ain't rocking with him like he wants them to.
